headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 8, 2026**
article:
The Seattle Mariners secured a 6-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Josh Naylor leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs. Andrés Muñoz earned the save, striking out 2 batters in 1 inning of work. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the Boston Red Sox 3-1, with Casey Legumina earning the win and Yandy Díaz leading the offense with a home run and 2 RBIs. The New York Yankees defeated the Cleveland Guardians 7-5, with David Bednar earning the win after 1.2 scoreless innings.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, impacting their teams' lineups. Austin Hays has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left calf strain with the Chicago White Sox. Carlos Rodriguez has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 31, 2026, with the Milwaukee Brewers. Adam Frazier has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 6, 2026, with the Los Angeles Angels due to right elbow inflammation. Vaughn Grissom has also been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 5, 2026, with the Los Angeles Angels due to a left oblique strain.

Several teams have made roster moves, including trades. The Arizona Diamondbacks traded RHP Taylor Rashi to the Minnesota Twins for cash. The Texas Rangers traded SS Richie Martin Jr. to the Colorado Rockies for cash. The Los Angeles Dodgers traded LHP Antoine Kelly to the Chicago Cubs for cash. The Athletics traded RHP Joel Kuhnel to the Milwaukee Brewers for cash.
